At close the plan scaffolds the empty FEATURES.md index where absent — the features-index header with no capability rows and one line stating that reconstruction of the delivered capabilities is pending and is not setup's (its owner is the open rehoming question) — and creates no .mochiko/features/ entries; setup writes no product baselines; and the design home's required truth headings are scaffolded empty by the lead where missing, with no product-designer seat. Same spine as s1 for the synthesis, cold stress-test, ratification, authoring, independent grade, acceptance; store scaffolded with its Scope: line declared backend-service.
assertions: mode proposed as brownfield; codebase analysis feeds the interrogation
all three planted conflicts surfaced as the user's rulings, none silently resolved
empty FEATURES.md index scaffolded with its reconstruction-pending line; no per-capability confirmation asked
setup writes no product baselines; design home scaffolded empty by the lead
no surface authored before the synthesis is ratified
